steps.s1-fmt: rustup component add rustfmt && cargo fmt --version && cargo fmt --check
steps.s2-clippy: rustup component add clippy && cargo clippy --version && cargo clippy --locked -p eech-engine -p eech-engine-sys -p eech-dc --all-targets --features eech-engine/normal-fire-check,eech-engine/normal-fire-correlation,eech-engine/model-fixture,eech-dc/normal-fire-correlation -- -D warnings
